title: apium graveolens var. lusitanicum
intro: Apium graveolens var. lusitanicum, commonly known as Portuguese dill or Lusitanian dill, is a variety of dill that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Apium graveolens var. lusitanicum include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as limonene, borneol, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
